name: Minimum Slice Coverage
description: Validates that slice coverage (SliceThickness x number of slices) meets a configurable minimum: warning below the minimum, optional hard error below a lower bound.
implementation:
slice_thickness = value["SliceThickness"].iloc[0]
num_slices = value["Count"].iloc[0]
coverage = slice_thickness * num_slices
hard_min = params.get("error_below_mm")
min_cov = params.get("min_coverage_mm")
if hard_min is not None and coverage < hard_min:
    raise ValidationError(f"Insufficient slice coverage: {coverage:.0f} mm (need >= {hard_min:g} mm). Found {num_slices} slices x {slice_thickness} mm.")
if min_cov is not None and coverage < min_cov:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Slice coverage ({coverage:.0f} mm) is below {min_cov:g} mm and may be insufficient.")

testCases.name: 90 mm passes when minimum lowered to 80
Coverage below the hard minimum fails

parameterDefinitions.name: min_coverage_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Minimum coverage
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if total coverage is below this

parameterDefinitions.name: error_below_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Hard minimum
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if total coverage is below this (optional)
